text:
Kira: Kitchen update — stash low. Anyone want to do a quick tea/biscuit run? also, the breakroom smells like... burnt popcorn? :nose:
Noah: I can go in 20 if no one objects. need oat milk?
Carmen: yes please to oat milk. and decaf pods if available.
Aj: i'll grab coffee beans too, we've been out of the medium roast tin for days :grimacing:
Katie: i'm on a biscuit boycott (gluten) but will happily accept fruit. maybe add granola bars?
PantryBot: Low-stock alert — `Earl Grey` tea (10% left), `Shortbread` biscuits (2 packs), `Oat Milk` (empty).
Kira: ok list so far:
```
Earl Grey x2 boxes
Oat Milk 2 cartons
Medium roast beans 1 bag
Shortbread 3 packs
Granola bars 1 box
Decaf pods 1 box
```
Noah: budget? don't want fancy stuff, just pantry staples.
Carmen: i'll chip in $5 via Venmo @carmen.
Aj: same — AjPay? jk, Venmo works.
Kira: who wants to lead the poll on breakroom scent? 😂 options: A) burnt popcorn B) leftover curry C) 3pm espresso fog D) new cleaning spray
Katie: C for sure. my office smells like espresso 24/7.
Noah: vote A — popcorn is haunting us.
Carmen: D, I actually like the new cleaner.
Aj: meh i'll go with B.
Kira: tally: A(1), B(1), C(1), D(1). perfect tie, so nobody wins. someone pick a winner or we defer to Runner (Noah).
Noah: i'll grab the list and some air freshener wipes. leaving in ~18. anyone need a specific snack?
Katie: can you also label the left-behind Tupperware in fridge? it's a chaos zone. :pray:
Carmen: yes please, the mystery curry Tupperware must go.
Aj: will put a sticky note system on top of the shelves — 'claimed' / 'free'
Kira: thanks y'all. i'll put a note in #kitchen with receipts and Venmo totals after. :thumbsup:
PantryBot: Purchase recorded: `Noah` bought items: Earl Grey(2), Oat Milk(2), Shortbread(3), Beans(1), Granola bars(1), Decaf pods(1). Receipt uploaded to /shared/kitchen/receipts/2246123456.pdf
Noah: back — mission accomplished. snacks inbound. :baguette_bread:
Katie: hero. cookies?
Noah: yes cookies and non-cookie items for Katie.
Kira: biscuit truce achieved. :tada:
